requirements.text: The rest of what paying opens up is shown rather than listed as text.
The feature the person hit is the one selected when the modal opens.
The headline names the feature the person hit.
Gold is the emphatic card whichever plan unlocks the gated feature.
Between four and six features are offered.
The features sit in one flat list, not grouped or nested.
The feature list is the same whichever gate fired.
Each feature in the list has a small looping video.
Switching to a feature changes its video and its copy together.
A still frame is present for every feature from first paint.
The still frame stays when the video has not loaded, cannot play, or the person has asked for reduced motion.
The video area is never empty.
Features that only Gold includes carry a lock mark.
Selecting a feature changes nothing on the plan cards.
When a discount is running, each plan card shows the money it saves.
When a discount is running, each plan card shows the percentage it saves.
The discount percentage is the same on both plan cards.
The money saved differs between the two plan cards.
A timer shows the time left on the discount.
The offer runs for one hour.
The hour starts once per person, not per view.
requirements.reason: a start time held per person across sessions is account state; the artifact can simulate it but cannot evidence it

requirements.text: Someone who returns inside the hour sees the time actually left, not a fresh hour.
Someone who returns after the hour sees the expired state.
No plan price appears in the modal.
The savings figure is not stated as a comparison against a base price.
Both plan cards can be bought.
At 390 the video and copy sit at the top.
At 390 the plan cards stack beneath the video and copy.
At 390 the feature list is a horizontal scroller.
Nothing present at 1440 is cut at 390.
The selected feature's video is playing when the modal opens.
In the no-offer state the savings figures, the timer and the discount badge are all absent together.
The no-offer state uses the same layout as the default state.
In the expired state a line saying the offer has ended replaces the timer.
In the expired state the savings figures are gone.
In the pending state the chosen plan's button acknowledges the click before checkout opens.
In the already-on-Pro state the Pro card reads as the person's current plan.
In the already-on-Pro state the Pro card cannot be bought.
In the video-unavailable state the feature copy is unchanged from the default state.
The modal is dismissed by the close control.
The modal is dismissed by a click outside it.
The modal is dismissed by Esc.
Dismissing the modal reveals what the person was doing, unchanged.
After dismissal the feature stays locked.
requirements.reason: what happens to the gated feature after the modal closes is host-app state, outside this artifact

requirements.text: No consolation offer is shown in place of buying.
No free single use of the feature is offered.
Which gate fired changes only the preselected feature and the headline.
At 1440 the layout is side by side.
No full plan-comparison table appears.
No contact-sales path appears.
Payment is not taken inside the modal.
The price-free savings presentation has been cleared by whoever owns pricing compliance.
requirements.reason: several markets require a reference price wherever a saving is advertised; the brief records this as needing a look from whoever owns pricing compliance before it ships

requirements.text: The modal shows on every gate hit, with no frequency cap.
requirements.reason: the brief's own words: whether that is too often cannot be settled by looking at the design, it needs usage data
